sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
FlipHTML5 is an online flipbook maker and digital publishing platform that converts PDF, PowerPoint, Word, and image files into interactive digital publications.

Industry: Software · Size: <$50M · Products: FlipHTML5 Flipbook Maker, AI Ebook Generator, PDF Chatbot, Online Art Gallery Maker, AI Assistant, Excel to Catalog

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: FlipHTML5 scores 7 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (9% similar on display, media, print, digital); ORAFOL Europe (8% similar on pdf, digital, website, code); Mactac (7% similar on digital, media, print, resources). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:

• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
